vref_dc.source: VREF is half of +2V8 (R3, R4): a value outside means ngspice settled on a false operating point

ctout_dc.source: U3 follows VREF at DC (C15 blocks its input)

music_hi.source: README, What it must do: music from 200 Hz to 10 kHz within -6 and +4 dB of its 1 kHz level, for the CE40-4 its sheet describes. Judged as written: the driver's own spread moves it further than the board can correct (Cms and Qms -20 %, Le +30 %: +8.0 and -7.8 dB; 48 Monte Carlo draws: +4.8 and -5.6 dB), README, Open items

music_100.source: README, What it must do: music at 100 Hz no more than 10 dB under its 1 kHz level; the CE40-4 alone is 11 dB under there
